tools.name: process
tools.description: Start a long-running shell command in the background and wait up to block_ms for it. If it finishes in time you get its exit code and output; otherwise you get an id and it keeps running: use the async tool to wait for, list, inspect or stop it. The command already runs in the background: do not use &, nohup, disown or daemonizing. Background children are killed when the command exits.

command.description: Shell command. It already runs in the background; do not add &, nohup or disown.

stdin.description: Text written once to the command's standard input, e.g. a script for `python3 -` or `node -`; the input is then closed.

cwd.description: Working directory. Defaults to the workspace.

block_ms.description: Most time to block for the exit. If it is still running an id is returned; collect it with the async tool.
